name: Fasshäusl
beschreibung:
Situated on the sunny slopes of Fuegenberg overlooking the lower Zillertal valley, Fasshaeusl captivates holidaymakers with rustic warmth and modern amenities. The lodge provides an ideal sanctuary for families and groups seeking alpine tranquillity.

The renowned ski resorts of Hochfuegen-Hochzillertal and Spieljoch are just a short drive away, while extensive hiking and biking trails await in summer.
kurzbeschreibung: Fasshaeusl in Fuegenberg offers charming chalet comfort and panoramic vistas across the Zillertal Alps.
